homonyms.basis: The census row carries no disambiguation field. No card is a homonym: all five concern the entity (four are the operator's own pages; the video carries the operator's executive director). 'AI Labor Market Tracker' and 'Evaluating the Impact of AI on the Labor Market' are the census's other names for it; the second is also the title of a distinct document, the first report of 1 October 2025 (B1), which the tracker continues. The distinct entities below are named by the field or the census beside the tracker and are never senses of its name.

captures.q: Yale Budget Lab AI labor market
captures.description: YALE BUDGET LAB AI LABOR MARKET, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'The AI Labor Market Tracker by The Budget Lab at Yale finds no clear evidence of large-scale or economy-wide labor market disruption from artificial intelligence.' Four findings (minimal economy-wide impact through September 2026; no unusual occupational churn; the synthetic differences-in-differences comparison; 'Capital vs. Labor') and the tracker's three sections. Five cards, four of them the Lab's own.
